title: Aye Alamdaare Wafa
body:
Ay Alamdaare wafa bazoo kataane wale
Ay Alamdaare wafa bazoo kataane wale
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko jhukaane wale
<<DIVIDER>>
1 Aaj jin haatho ne mashikize me bharli hai Furaat
Kal yahi haath pe Khaybar ko uthane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
2 Tujhko darya ki rawaani ka salaam aayaa hai
Khoon paani ke iwaz apna bahane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
3 Panjetan apna karam tujpe karege hardam
Parchame Hazrat-e-Abbas uthaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
4 Do Moharram se jo faaqaa tha to tha magar raha
Qaadare karte hai ab teri zamaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
5 Naok-e-naiza pe tilaawat se kiya hai saabit
Kaon Quran pe khanjar hai chalaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
6 Hum pe haste hai tere qatla me shamil the jo log
Tujh pe rote hai teri yaad manaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
7 Sar qalam ho gayaa Islam bachaane ke liye
Aise hote hai Mohammed ke gharaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
8 Mai bhi Rehaan yuhi likhta rahuga naohe
Jab talak zinda hai naoho ko sunaane waale
<<MINI>>
Jhuk gaye khud tere parcham ko julaane waale
